verdict.rationale: Bevy is dual-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0, explicitly 'free and open-source forever,' with 'no contracts, no license fees, no sales cuts,' and community sentiment corroborates the permissive, no-strings license as a selling point. These licenses are irrevocable and non-relicensable retroactively by nature, giving strong structural assurance against repricing already-shipped games. missing for 10: no explicit historical case study or independent legal analysis confirming no retroactive license changes have ever occurred across Bevy's version history.
